about.title: The old quay
about.html:
Until 1994 ships from the Baltic unloaded larch at this quay. Four buildings, a public promenade and three restored cranes now share its edge, facing the old town across the water.

The timber yard closed thirty years ago. We kept what made it a harbour: the granite edge, the cranes, the 1912 brick store and the pier where the water tram now stops.

advantages.title: Your own pier
advantages.text: The water tram calls at the quay every 15 minutes from 6:30 until midnight. Old Town Pier is nine minutes away.

advantages.title: Three cranes, kept
advantages.text: The portal cranes from 1958 were stripped, repainted in their original oxide red and fitted with lights that come on at dusk.

advantages.title: The Larch Store
advantages.text: The 1912 brick warehouse is now the community house: a gym, a café, rooms to work in and a nursery for 60 children.

advantages.title: A courtyard without cars
advantages.text: Cars stay underground in 310 spaces. Above them the courtyard is planted with birches and has room for 900 bicycles.

advantages.title: Ceilings of 3.1 metres
advantages.text: Homes in Quayside have 3.1 m ceilings and windows from floor to ceiling. In the other three buildings ceilings are 2.9 m.

advantages.title: Heat from the harbour
advantages.text: Sea-water heat pumps under the pier heat every home and the community house. There are no gas boilers on the quay.

advantages.title: Larch on every facade
advantages.text: The boards arrive amber and turn silver within three winters, the colour of the old quay.

faq.q: When will I get the keys?
faq.a:
Quayside in Q4 2027, Crane House in Q2 2028, Yard and Terrace in Q3 2028.

The date for your home is in your contract.

faq.q: How much is the reservation fee?
faq.a:
£2,000.

It is deducted from the price and refunded in full if you withdraw within 14 days.

faq.q: Can I buy with a mortgage?
faq.a:
Yes.

The rates on this page are indicative; your adviser will confirm the offer for your deposit and term.

faq.q: What finish do the homes have?
faq.a:
Every home comes with a larch floor, a fitted kitchen and a finished bathroom.

Walls are painted white.

A space is included with three- and four-bedroom homes.

Other homes can add one for £28,000.

Underfloor heating from sea-water heat pumps under the pier.

There is no gas on the quay.

Yes.
